title: Schdlr (Scheduling & Invoicing SaaS)
description: A multi-tenant appointment scheduling and invoicing SaaS for service businesses, designed with React, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, Prisma, Cognito, SES, EventBridge, and Stripe.

title: aliahhmad.com (Personal Portfolio)
description: A personal portfolio website showcasing projects, experience, and skills — designed and built from scratch with react and express to reflect a clean, modern developer identity.

title: App Brewery Course Projects
description: A collection of full-stack capstone projects built through Angela Yu's Complete Web Development Bootcamp — covering HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, and React.

title: Predicting Default Risk of Lending Club Loans
description: A machine learning project that predicts Lending Club loan default risk from 2.26M accepted loans, using leakage-aware preprocessing, time-ordered validation, and tuned Logistic Regression, MLP, and XGBoost models.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Traffic Routing
description: An AI project that models New York State roads as a probabilistic graph, using UCS, A* search, traffic-aware costs, and Monte Carlo simulation to find routes that balance speed and reliability under uncertain congestion.
